attributes.board_name: Washington Occupational Therapy Practice Board (Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least two activity types; at least 20 hours directly related to OT practice. CE courses; employer in-service or study groups (max 15); professional conferences/workshops; post-degree college coursework (1 credit = 5 h, max 15); interactive online courses and webinars; presentations incl. posters (max 10); guest lecturing (max 10); publications (peer-reviewed max 10, other max 5); instructional media (max 10); manuscript review (max 10); board/committee service (max 10); self-study with synopsis (max 10); student supervision (40 h = 1 h, max 12); mentoring (max 5, not toward the 20); Board meetings (max 2); WA jurisprudence exam at 100% (0.5 h).
rules.audit_note: Submit documentation upon request under chapter 246-12 WAC (DOH CE audit); keep suicide-training documentation 6 years.

topics.who: Suicide assessment training meeting WAC 246-847-066, every 6 years (first in the first full reporting period after initial licensure, with a possible 6-year deferral if completed within 6 years before licensure)
Health equity CE meeting RCW 43.70.613 / WAC 246-12-800 to -830, every 4 years since Jan 1, 2024; counts toward the 24

rules.notes: Requirement reduced from 30 to 24 hours every two years effective July 1, 2025.
